aggregation: one official score per held-out context, drug, and dose; context and drug fixed effects; drug-cluster bootstrap
axis_name: Tahoe administered-dose displacement for the ST-SE checkpoint
confirmation_set: official ST-SE-Tahoe few-shot state_generalization_X_state eval_best score tables for C32, HOP62, HepG2-C3A, Hs 766T, and PANC-1; none read before this freeze
deduplication: one normalized context-drug-dose row from each official ST-SE result table
direction: lower administered dose predicts lower ST-SE performance
distance_metric: negative base-10 log dose in uM, standardized over the three balanced levels; larger values mean weaker/lower-dose challenge
error_spending_plan: one ST-SE best-checkpoint look; last-checkpoint and zero-shot tables are sensitivities only and cannot rescue failure of the primary
fixed_reference: equal-training-cell-line mean Tahoe pseudobulk LFC vector for the same drug-dose, scored against the same held-out response over the same significant-real-DE genes; predictions consume no held-out outcome
gene_set: official released significant-real-DE gene set used by de_spearman_lfc_sig for each target condition
hypothesis_source: predeclared dose mechanism; corrected sign before any ST-SE Tahoe score table was read after A7's textual sign contradiction was detected
inclusion_exclusion: intersection of the five official test lists; retain 199 drugs having all three doses in every held-out context; vehicle excluded; finite official scores only with all missingness reported
level_rule: three fixed experimental levels 5.0, 0.5, and 0.05 uM; no data-dependent binning
mechanism_gate: adjust for held-out nDE and cell support; if absorbed, reattribute the mechanism to response magnitude or measurement floor and retain administered dose only as the prospective experimental proxy
metric: official de_spearman_lfc_sig; primary coefficient is Fisher-z score on standardized negative log dose with drug and context fixed effects
normalization: official cell-eval signed log-fold-change Spearman score; Fisher z for regression
power_plan: one primary look using every available one of 199 complete drug clusters; 10,000 drug-cluster bootstrap draws preserving all dose/context observations
prospective_features: ordered administered concentration within each drug: 5.0, 0.5, and 0.05 uM
reference_gate: after establishing real ST-SE degradation, compare its slope with the same-example fixed reference and classify larger, comparable, or smaller; shared degradation remains a valid failure
sample_size_target: at least 150 complete drug clusters; planned maximum 199 drugs and 2,985 units
success_criteria: certify directional degradation only if the primary negative-log-dose coefficient and its 95% drug-block bootstrap interval are below zero and mean performance at 0.05 uM is below 5.0 uM
target_access_state: ST-HVG C32 file header and initial rows were inspected after A7; no ST-SE Tahoe result, prediction, real-DE, or aggregate table was read before this A8 freeze
unit: held-out Tahoe cell line x drug x dose
